newsitem.title: CANADA: Digital Processing holders to sell warrants.
newsitem.headline: Digital Processing holders to sell warrants.

text.p: Digital Processing Systems Inc said on Friday a group of its common shareholders agreed to sell 736,644 special warrants at C$12.625 per warrant for total proceeds of C$9.3 million.
The company said none of its officers or directors will participate in the secondary offering and senior managment will continue to own about 54 percent of the outstanding shares.

Each warrant is convertible without further consideration into one common share when the prospectus is cleared in the relevant provinces on or before 90 days after closing, which is expected to be November 5.
The underwriting syndicate will be led by Midland Walwyn Capital Inc.
